review: Sixteen complete gesture figures, matching the base character. Kneel, crouch, bow, blink, look, folded arms, wave, cheer, laugh, drink, kiss, point, fear, headache and victory are clearly differentiated. Cell11 kiss faces right rather than requested left and has a small separate heart effect: mirror the figure if necessary and exclude the heart from native body extraction. Other cells do not contain extra effects. Native resampling/quantization remains required.
